name: Double Commander
engine: Built-in image viewer (Image32, optional libheif/libjxl/librsvg); media via WLX plugins (Quick Look on macOS, WMP on Windows, MPlayer on Linux)
summary: Free, open-source two-panel file manager inspired by Total Commander, including its plugin interface. Runs natively on Apple silicon, with tabs, Find Files with regex, multi-rename, archives as folders and a built-in viewer for text and images.
where_it_wins: Full Total Commander-style file manager on the Mac: sync dirs, multi-rename, checksums, FTP/SFTP
Viewer can crop, resize and save images
where_schnellbild_wins: Real video player with MKV/AVI/WebM via VLC, skim with arrow keys
Thumbnail grid with folder previews, photos and videos together
Recursive slideshow with photos and videos mixed
Modern formats (HEIC, AVIF, JPEG XL, WebP) work out of the box on the Mac
Runs in the App Sandbox, never goes online; signed, notarized, build attested
Undo for renames, moves and trash

no_account_no_tracking.note: Open source, no account or ads.

dark_light_setting.note: Dark mode: Auto / Enabled / Disabled (macOS, Windows 10 1809+).

thumbnail_grid.note: Thumbnails view (Quick Look on macOS); folders show icons, no folder previews.

recursive_search.note: Find Files with subfolder depth; also Flat view of all subfolders.

network_shares_fast.note: SMB/network access (Windows network, GVfs, samba plugin); speed not documented.

multiple_windows.note: Tabs in two panes; viewer/editor open in separate windows.

img_modern_formats.note: HEIC/AVIF/JPEG XL/WebP need extra libraries (libheif, libjxl, libwebp) or WIC on Windows; on macOS via the bundled Quick Look viewer plugin.

img_raw.note: Windows via WIC RAW codecs; macOS via Quick Look plugin.

img_psd_exr.note: PSD built in; OpenEXR not listed.

img_svg_pdf.note: SVG built in; PDF via Quick Look plugin on macOS or other WLX plugins.

img_animated.note: Animated GIF with frame controls; APNG/animated WebP not listed.

keyboard_paging.note: Previous/Next file commands in the viewer, hotkeys configurable.

zoom_rotate.note: Zoom, rotate, mirror in the viewer.

slideshow.note: Only in full-screen viewer, current folder, 1-25 s per image.

slideshow_recursive.note: Slideshow covers the current directory only.

file_info_exif.note: Built-in Exif content plugin (JPEG: date, size, orientation, camera).

wrong_extension_note.note: Viewer and command reference contain no such notice

video_native.note: No own player: macOS via Quick Look viewer plugin, Windows via WMP plugin, Linux via MPlayer plugin.

video_mkv_avi_webm.note: Linux: embedded MPlayer plugin handles AVI/MKV/FLV/MPG/MP4/VOB; macOS: only what Quick Look plays; Windows: WMP plugin

photos_videos_one_grid.note: Thumbnails view uses OS thumbnailers (Quick Look on macOS), so videos appear with frames where the OS supplies them.

video_skim_arrows.note: On macOS video plays in a Quick Look view (MacPreview plugin); Double Commander adds no player controls of its own, and what the Quick Look controls offer is not documented (searched DC docs, source, issues)

subtitles_embedded.note: On macOS video plays in a Quick Look view (MacPreview plugin); Double Commander adds no player controls of its own, and what the Quick Look controls offer is not documented (searched DC docs, source, issues)

subtitles_external_files.note: Viewer has no subtitle function; macOS plugin is a plain Quick Look view

audio_track_choice.note: On macOS video plays in a Quick Look view (MacPreview plugin); Double Commander adds no player controls of its own, and what the Quick Look controls offer is not documented (searched DC docs, source, issues)

playback_speed.note: On macOS video plays in a Quick Look view (MacPreview plugin); Double Commander adds no player controls of its own, and what the Quick Look controls offer is not documented (searched DC docs, source, issues)

control_bar_movable.note: On macOS video plays in a Quick Look view (MacPreview plugin); Double Commander adds no player controls of its own, and what the Quick Look controls offer is not documented (searched DC docs, source, issues)

playlist.note: Viewer has no playlist; media plays one file at a time through WLX plugins

pip.note: On macOS video plays in a Quick Look view (MacPreview plugin); Double Commander adds no player controls of its own, and what the Quick Look controls offer is not documented (searched DC docs, source, issues)

music_mode.note: Audio plays one file at a time in the viewer plugin (Quick Look on macOS); bundled audioinfo content plugin shows tags as columns

streaming_urls.note: Viewer opens local files (or files fetched by FTP/cloud plugins); no stream URLs

video_filters_enhance.note: Image adjustments exist only for pictures; no video adjustments in viewer or plugins

quicklook_mkv_thumbnails.note: Uses Quick Look, does not add generators.

archives_as_folders.note: macOS: ZIP, TAR, GZ, BZ2, LZMA built in, RAR via bundled UnRAR plugin; the 7-Zip plugin is Windows/Linux only, so 7z needs an external 7zz set up in MultiArc (open #1669)

comics_cbz_cbr.note: No comic reader; CBZ/CBR open as folders once the extensions are assigned to the Zip/UnRAR packer plugins in Options > Plugins > WCX

archive_passwords.note: Password supported for packers/external archivers; per-format.

split_archives.note: Multi-volume RAR via the UnRAR plugin (volume change callback); MultiArc packs volumes (%V); Split/Combine file commands

videos_in_archives.note: F3 extracts the file to a temp folder and opens it.

manga_two_page.note: Viewer has no two-page or right-to-left mode

undo_file_actions.note: No undo command for file operations.

image_editing.note: Viewer can crop, resize, rotate, red-eye, draw and save (BMP/ICO/JPEG/PNG/PNM).

batch_convert.note: Multi-Rename Tool yes; no batch image conversion.

library_catalog.note: descript.ion file comments; Finder tags on macOS; no ratings database.

cloud_sync.note: iCloud Drive access and MacCloud plugin (OAuth/S3 drivers), FTP/SFTP; no sync.

custom_shortcuts.note: Keys > Hot Keys, multiple shortcut files.

shortcut_cheatsheet.note: Keyboard layout page in the docs; not a printable sheet.

boss_key.note: Command reference lists only cm_Minimize for the own window; no global hide hotkey

app_sandbox.note: Asks for Full Disk Access on macOS.

notarized_attested.note: macOS release script signs the app ad hoc (codesign --sign '-'), no notarization or build attestation

mac_app_store.note: Not in the Mac App Store (store search finds no Double Commander); DMG from GitHub/SourceForge
